test_GlfwKeyboard_single_event: test the GlfwKeyboard handler to process a single key press event with modifiers
test_GlfwKeyboard_sequence_events: test the GlfwKeyboard handler to process a sequence of key press and release events
test_GlfwMouse_move: test the GlfwMouse handler to track mouse position and calculate translation deltas
test_GlfwMouse_click: test the GlfwMouse handler to process mouse button click events with modifiers
test_GlfwWindow_fullscreen: test the GlfwWindow to enable fullscreen mode using video mode and window position
